set.body: PdfRenderer.validateGlyphs passed each Unicode code point to PDType0Font.hasGlyph, which takes a character code (for Identity-H, a glyph index). U+2013 was refused in IBM Plex Sans (reported by eyes4s at pin 56506d28) and in Liberation Sans although the cmap maps it; an unmapped code point inside the glyph index range (U+0378) passed validation and failed later as PdfEncodingFailed. Fix: validate through the face's Unicode cmap (getCmapLookup), the lookup showText encodes through.
set.title: [Intaglio] PDF glyph validation tests a code point as a glyph index (refuses U+2013)
